title: The Red Cliff Drone Dilemma
setting: Nestled in southern Utah’s Cedar Mesa backcountry, the all-volunteer Red Cliff Mountain Rescue team just took possession of their first donated drone—a gently used DJI Air 2S—after months of small community fundraisers. For years, the team has relied on foot patrols and satellite messengers to search for lost campers and fallen climbers, often taking four or more hours to cover expansive, unmarked desert terrain. Local backcountry outfitters and grieving family members of recent lost hikers are now pressuring the team to deploy the drone to cut search times dramatically, splitting the volunteer ranks over how to use the new gear safely.

characters.name: Mara Hines
characters.tendencies: She fixates on liability waivers and lack of formal certification, arguing the drone must stay grounded until all team members complete approved flight training.

characters.name: Javi Torres
characters.tendencies: He’s a frontline rescue volunteer who wants to use the drone to save lives immediately, dismissing minor operational risks to push for unregulated test flights with the team’s sole part-time trained operator.

characters.name: Lila Marquez
characters.tendencies: She’s the only team member with basic drone flight experience, torn between following Mara’s cautious rules and wanting to prove the drone’s life-saving potential to her fellow volunteers.
